summary.en: To get job counselling or referrals, register as a job seeker. Take your residence card and passport to the Nagoya Employment Service Center for Foreigners or a nearby Hello Work. Interpreters cover 10 languages, but not every day, so ask in advance. Ask at the counter whether part-time jobs are also introduced (to be checked). You need work permission before you start paid work, not to look for work. Employers check your card, so getting it early helps (advice, not a rule).
